action_item_for_main_agent: One minor UI issue: Language switcher in Nav navigates to homepage instead of staying on admin dashboard. Consider adding logic to preserve current route when switching languages, or document this as expected behavior if intentional.

success_percentage.frontend: 95% (all core features working, 1 minor navigation issue)

detailed_notes.backend_testing: All 18 backend API tests passed successfully. Tested authentication, stats, applications CRUD, PDF/Excel exports in both FR and EN, conversations/messaging, and butin (donations) management. All endpoints return correct status codes and data.
detailed_notes.frontend_testing: Comprehensive Playwright tests executed covering login flows, dashboard display, filters, search, application row expansion, status changes, note input, export modals, tab navigation, butin panel, logout, session persistence, and responsive design. All core functionality working correctly.
detailed_notes.pirate_theme_ui: The redesigned 'Pont de commandement' (Command Deck) UI is visually impressive with pirate theme elements: brass portholes, ship wheels, wax seals, rope lines, deck planks, map grids, and nautical coordinates. All decorative elements render correctly without breaking functionality.
detailed_notes.responsive_design: Tested on mobile (390x844) and desktop (1920x800). No horizontal overflow detected. The rotating circle inside admin-command-deck is intentionally clipped by overflow-hidden parent as per design.
detailed_notes.data_integrity: Test applications (TestAlpha, TestBravo) were not deleted as instructed. Status changes were tested and restored to original values.
detailed_notes.export_functionality: Both PDF and Excel exports work in French and English. Export modal correctly prompts for language selection before download.
detailed_notes.real_applications: Found 2 real applications in the system (TestBravo in reserve, TestAlpha pending). Did not delete or permanently modify these as per instructions.
